rationale: The D0 direction that used to be ACCEPTED: '.'(0x2E) sorts before 'Z'(0x5A), so a lexicographic comparison read 10:00:00.5Z -> 10:00:00Z as increasing. Parsed instants reject it. If this fixture ever passes, D0 has regressed.
cross_field_note: The JSON Schema layer ACCEPTS this instance; only the released x-datacompany-cross-field rules reject it. Both engines evaluate those rules, so this fixture is replayed at full parity — Python via validate_instance and TypeScript via evaluateCrossFieldRules — and expected_error_contains for it is the RULE NAME, which both emit verbatim from the schema, rather than a validator's English prose (defect D2f). expected_schema_failures is empty by construction: that emptiness is the definition of cross_field_only, and both harnesses assert it.
